第三十章 剑吞魂力灵狐暗中破敌（第1页）
莹白灵力凝聚成护罩，苏晚晴直面两名筑基后期魔宗修士。
双方修为差距悬殊，黑袍人抬手一挥，浓稠黑雾裹挟凌厉煞气刃芒破空而出，攻势连绵不绝。短短数个回合，苏晚晴的灵力护罩便轰然破碎，煞气余劲划伤肩头，阴冷毒素侵入经脉，让她半边身躯发麻，只能步步后退，勉强牵制二人，根本无法发起反击。
另一侧战场，赵磊横刀迎战两具铁甲尸傀，全力催动横练肉身，长刀全力劈砍在厚重铁甲之上，只迸溅出阵阵火星，连一道裂痕都无法留下。
尸傀无痛无感，不知疲倦，铁臂蛮横横扫，巨力轰然压下。赵磊心神受同门惨死影响，躲闪出现破绽，胸口硬生生挨了一记重击，身躯倒飞而出，重重砸落地面，口中鲜血喷涌，身受不轻内伤。
许巧不停抛洒青色驱煞药粉，药雾笼罩尸傀周身，只能微弱压制体表尸气，完全无法阻挡尸傀他抬手一剑劈出，专克尸邪的阴寒剑意瞬间爆发，坚硬铁甲如同纸片一般碎裂，剑光径直贯穿尸傀核心魂核，强悍尸傀当场僵直倒地，被一剑秒杀。
陈默迈步上前，直面逼近的两具铁甲尸傀，缓缓拔出腰间阴魂剑。
漆黑剑身毫无灵光，看上去平平无奇，可剑锋出鞘刹那，周遭气温骤降。感觉能够让周围的人遁入黑暗。
尸傀溃散之后，灰色魂力缓缓飘散，尽数被阴魂剑自主吸纳，丝丝缕缕魂力顺着剑身涌入陈默体内，快速弥补他消耗的灵力，同时一点点淬炼剑身，让阴魂剑锋芒更盛。
另一具尸傀悍然扑杀而至，速度迅猛。
身前白狐身形一晃，化作一道肉眼难辨的雪白残影，爪尖微光一闪，瞬间撕裂尸傀外层防御尸气，精准破开致命破绽。
陈默抓住空隙，顺势补出一剑，第二具尸傀同样应声倒地，残存魂力再度被阴魂剑吞噬殆尽。
灵狐一击建功，立刻退回陈默身侧，再度收敛全部气息，低调蛰伏，不抢分毫风头，可这一闪而过的速度与杀伤力，已然远超在场所有筑基修士。
陈默心念一动，直接引动地底预埋已久的绝杀埋伏符，赤红符文光柱冲天而起，大范围绝杀之力封锁整片隘口，场内残余尸气与煞气被彻底肃清。
两名魔宗修士见状，他们突然间想起了当年一个魔修强者的阴魂剑。听说这把剑可以吸取阴魂之物的魂力来，提升自己是魂道修行的顶级武器。但在某一次魔派与正派的斗争中这位大能。在其中陨落了，而这把剑也没有任何一个人知道他的下落。如今他们能把这件带回宗门一定能够受到宗门的嘉奖。甚至可以祝他们突破到金丹。于是他们心头立马火热了起来。
他们二人彻底放弃缠斗苏晚晴，双双调转方向，全速朝着陈默冲杀而来，眼中满是对阴魂剑的贪婪，一心想要强行夺剑。推进脚步，战场局势从开战之初便一路崩盘。

Chapter 30 The sword-swallowing spirit fox secretly defeats the enemy (page 1)
Yingbai spiritual power condensed into a protective shield, and Su Wanqing faced two demon sect monks in the late stage of foundation building.
There was a huge gap in cultivation between the two sides. The man in black robe raised his hand and waved, thick black mist wrapped in fierce evil energy and a blade of light shot out of the air. The offensive was continuous. In just a few rounds, Su Wanqing's spiritual shield was shattered, and the evil energy left a scratch on her shoulder. The cold toxin invaded the meridians, making half of her body numb. She could only retreat step by step, barely restraining the two of them, and was unable to launch a counterattack.
On the other side of the battlefield, Zhao Lei faced off against two armored zombies with his sword. He used all his strength to move Heng Lian's body, and slashed at the thick iron armor with all his strength. Only bursts of sparks flew out, leaving not even a crack.
The corpse puppet is painless and tireless, its iron arms sweep across brutally, and it presses down with huge force. Zhao Lei's mind was affected by the tragic death of his classmate, and he had a flaw in his dodge. He was hit hard on the chest, and his body flew out and hit the ground hard. Blood spurted out of his mouth, and he suffered serious internal injuries.
Xu Qiao kept throwing green evil-dispelling medicine powder, and the medicine mist enveloped the corpse puppet, which could only weakly suppress the corpse energy on the surface, but was completely unable to stop the corpse puppet.
Chen Mo stepped forward, faced the two armored corpse puppets approaching, and slowly pulled out the Yinhun Sword from his waist.
The pitch-black sword blade had no aura and looked ordinary, but the moment the blade was unsheathed, the surrounding temperature dropped sharply. It feels like it can make those around you escape into darkness.
After the corpse puppet collapsed, the gray soul power slowly drifted away and was absorbed by the Yin Soul Sword. Wisps of soul power poured into Chen Mo's body along the sword body, quickly making up for the spiritual power he had consumed. At the same time, the sword body was tempered little by little, making the Yin Soul Sword even more sharp.
Another corpse puppet rushed towards him with great speed.
The figure of the white fox in front of him swayed, turning into a snow-white afterimage that was difficult to discern with the naked eye. The tip of his claws flashed, instantly tearing apart the corpse puppet's outer layer of defensive corpse energy, accurately breaking through the fatal flaw.
Chen Mo seized the gap and used the opportunity to draw out a sword. The second corpse also fell to the ground, and the remaining soul power was once again swallowed up by the Haunted Soul Sword.
Linghu made a successful attack and immediately retreated to Chen Mo's side. He once again gathered all his aura and lay dormant in a low profile, trying not to steal any of the limelight. However, the speed and lethality of this flash far exceeded all the foundation-building monks present.
With a thought in Chen Mo's mind, he directly activated the killing ambush talisman that had been buried underground for a long time. The red rune light pillar rose into the sky, and the large-scale killing power blocked the entire pass, and the remaining corpse energy and evil energy in the field were completely eliminated.
When the two Demon Sect monks saw this, they suddenly remembered the Ghost Sword of a strong Demon Cultivator back then. I heard that this sword can absorb the soul power of ghost objects and improve itself. It is the top weapon for soul cultivation. But in a certain struggle between the demon sect and the righteous, this powerful man. He died in it, and no one knows the whereabouts of this sword. Now if they can bring this back to the sect, they will definitely be rewarded by the sect. You can even wish them a breakthrough to the golden elixir. So their hearts immediately became hot.
The two of them gave up fighting Su Wanqing completely, and both turned around and charged towards Chen Mo at full speed. Their eyes were full of greed for the Yinhun Sword, and they wanted to seize the sword by force. Moving forward, the battlefield situation collapsed from the beginning of the war.
